name: Claude Cowork
tagline: Claude Code's agentic harness, repointed at non-coding knowledge work.
insight: Microsoft picked Claude over its OpenAI stack to power Copilot Cowork, the Microsoft 365 counterpart it launched in March 2026.
description: Anthropic's agentic desktop mode that completes multi-step knowledge work end-to-end. Point it at local folders and connected apps and it organizes files, builds spreadsheets, and prepares reports — showing its plan for approval before significant actions. Launched as a research preview in January 2026, it is now included in every paid Claude plan on macOS and Windows.

modelSupport.notes: Anthropic-only; runs on your existing paid Claude plan.

edge: Brings Claude Code's local-file agent harness to non-developers — it edits real files in scoped folders, not just chat outputs.
pros: Scoped folder access with plan approval
Bundled into existing paid Claude plans
cons: Desktop-only — no web or mobile version
Long agentic runs can burn plan usage limits

references.title: Claude Cowork expands to all paid plans on macOS and Windows
